verdict.rationale: telli documents automatic data retention deletion (contacts and call data purged once they reach a defined age) and conditional consent-based recording, giving users some control over data lifecycle and privacy. However, there's no evidence of user-initiated manual deletion, export/right-to-access tools, or granular per-record deletion controls beyond the age-based policy. missing for 10: manual/on-demand deletion controls, data export capability, independent verification of retention enforcement.
